list.name: run_status
list.label: Run status
list.query: any : .*, passed : ^passed$, failed : ^failed$, still running : ^running$, error : ^error$, generated but not run : ^generated$, no test_runs row : ^$

panels.title: What this list covers
panels.description: The three app tables do not nest, so most runs appear in only one of them. Measured 2026-08-13: 528 runs with a UUID-shaped id, of which 415 have a workflow_metrics row, 45 have a test_runs row and 123 have an execution_records row. 113 have no metrics row at all. Read a blank cell in the table below as 'that table holds nothing for this run', not as a fault. stuck_at_running counts test_runs rows still at 'running' — 8 of the 45, runs that died without reaching either terminal path. The two filter variables do not move this panel; it always describes the whole population. Excluded from every panel here: 32 synthetic workflow_metrics rows dated 2026-06-25 whose workflow_id is not a UUID (t1, t2, t3, live-t1, ts-test, msg-test, status-test, full-e2e-1, mapping-test, multi-test) — the same real-runs filter the locator-reliability dashboard uses, so the two describe one population. All-time: this dashboard has no usable time column and its picker is hidden — see the panel below and observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: WITH ids AS (SELECT run_id AS id FROM test_runs WHERE run_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' UNION SELECT workflow_id FROM workflow_metrics WHERE workflow_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' UNION SELECT workflow_id FROM execution_records WHERE workflow_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') SELECT count(*) AS runs, count(m.id) AS with_metrics_row, count(tr.run_id) AS with_run_row, count(er.workflow_id) AS with_execution_record, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tr.status = 'running') AS stuck_at_running FROM ids LEFT JOIN workflow_metrics m ON m.workflow_id = ids.id LEFT JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.run_id = ids.id LEFT JOIN execution_records er ON er.workflow_id = ids.id

panels.title: Every run this install has a record of
panels.description: One row per run over the union of test_runs, workflow_metrics and execution_records. Newest first, and 'newest' needs explaining: 374 of the 528 runs carry no timestamp in any app table, because workflow_metrics has only the naive ts column that a guard forbids reading. The sort key is therefore workflow_metrics.id, an identity counter the application never supplies itself, so it is exact insertion order. Checked against the app timestamps on the 41 rows carrying both keys: 0 rank inversions in 820 compared pairs, so this ordering is chronologically faithful rather than a proxy. The 113 runs with no metrics row sort below all of them, ordered by started_at. run_wall_s is workflow_duration_s, the whole generation run — both crew kickoffs, the element stage and the dryrun gate. browser_stage_s is execution_time, the browser-use element stage alone, which runs 45% of the run's wall time on average and never exceeds it. They are a part and a whole, not two measurements of one thing. gate reads '(none recorded)' on the runs whose dryrun_status is absent or a JSON null; that is not a gate failure. No LIMIT by design — an inventory that hides rows is not an inventory, and the unbounded query measured 4.8 ms against 4.6 ms capped at 200. Click a run id to open it in Trace one run. All-time: this dashboard has no usable time column and its picker is hidden — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: WITH ids AS (SELECT run_id AS id FROM test_runs WHERE run_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' UNION SELECT workflow_id FROM workflow_metrics WHERE workflow_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' UNION SELECT workflow_id FROM execution_records WHERE workflow_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') SELECT ids.id AS run_id, m.id AS metrics_seq, tr.created_at AS started_at, coalesce(tr.status, '(no run row)') AS run_status, coalesce(er.test_status, '(not executed)') AS executed_as, coalesce(m.data->>'dryrun_status', '(none recorded)') AS gate, round((m.data->>'total_cost')::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd, round((m.data->>'workflow_duration_s')::numeric, 1) AS run_wall_s, round((m.data->>'execution_time')::numeric, 1) AS browser_stage_s, (m.data->>'failed_elements')::int AS elements_lost, coalesce(tr.user_query, er.user_query) AS user_query FROM ids LEFT JOIN workflow_metrics m ON m.workflow_id = ids.id LEFT JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.run_id = ids.id LEFT JOIN execution_records er ON er.workflow_id = ids.id WHERE coalesce(tr.status, '') ~ ${run_status:sqlstring} AND coalesce(er.test_status, '') ~ ${outcome:sqlstring} ORDER BY m.id DESC NULLS LAST, tr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
